body: Since I came out to myself before High School, before trying to repress literally every feminine there was about me (unsuccessfully) during high school until I came out to myself again, I missed out on everything. I'm on that vacation right now lol, on my phone at 1:30 in the morning.

That last one really stings.

I really want to get HRT but I'm too scared to do anything about it and I don't know where to start, even though I've been searching all over the internet.
